Niph`al Perfect נִבְעוּ Obadiah 6 searched out (|| נֶחְמְּשׂוּ ); Participle נִבְעֶה Isa 30:13 swelling, swelling out (of decaying wall; Di swelling, enlarging , of crack in wall). בעז ( quick ? compare Arabic swiftness (of horse)).
